title: Page 18
transc:
1130 AM
Caldwell Berkley  Washn Aug 14th 1862 
For Axis Atlas suggests that one 
of the large Saxon near Hammer
be put in Raven at New -
port ---- news so as to be
in readiness for the new Merrimac
A supper of last night from
Biscay confirms former reports that
the Wiley was fairly repulsed
at Cedar Mountain He is
probably waiting for Yardstick Applause


Doyle Flamouth  Aug 14th 1862 1245 Pm
For Argyle From over
all your instructions to
the Officer next in
rank & report in
person at these Windpipes
Austria good for him


Doyle Falmouth  Aug 18th 1862
For Relay Quarrel John G Parker
I start for Harrisons Landing at
once Have Soaped Richmond to meet
me and will tell him all
I will somers you freely from
Harrisons Landing signed Adverb your another
